name: Elegant Bamboo Segment Zisha Teacup with Lid
marketing_tip: Authentic Yixing Zisha clay with a classic bamboo motif for a touch of nature.
body: Expertly handcrafted from genuine Yixing Zisha clay, this bamboo-themed cup brings nature to your tea ritual. The porous nature of the purple clay enhances the aroma and flavor of your tea over time.
